name: Lord Ganesha
shortDescription: Lord of beginnings, invoked first before every auspicious undertaking.
description: Ganesha, beloved son of Shiva and Parvati, is honoured first at every beginning. With the ankusha he guides, with the pasha he gently draws devotees close, and with the modak he reminds us of the sweetness of wisdom. Bring your new beginnings here, and begin with a quiet, grateful heart.

mantra.meaning: Salutations to Ganapati, lord of beginnings.

art.imageAlt: The sacred syllable Om with ankusha, pasha and modaks
